messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx and tail latency observed for Hosted API (us-east-2) and several Dedicated pools. Source: third-party auth/credential calls. Pager triggered to #incidents. Ops runbook v2 referenced.
oncall-sre-janet: Got it, paging in. I'm taking this. :rotating_light:
eng-runtime-omar: Seeing spikes in token exchange errors to sts.amazonaws.com from edge proxies. Sample 1m error rate: 12% -> 503s
platform-ops-li: Dedicated pool ded-us2-a shows throughput drop, queued requests rising. Latency P95 -> 980ms. Affected routes: /v1/chat and /v1/generate.
oncall-sre-janet: Quick checks: `curl -I https://sts.us-east-2.amazonaws.com` -> intermittent 503s. Log tail:
```
2026-03-17T14:05:02Z proxy-127.0.0.1 sts.amazonaws.com 503 "ServiceUnavailable"
2026-03-17T14:05:07Z auth-proxy ded-us2-a token-exchange 502
```
eng-runtime-omar: Confirmed similar traces in Kibana: upstream stall at auth-proxy, increased retry loops causing KV cache pressure on runtime nodes.
platform-ops-li: Taking immediate action: 1) Add temporary routing rule to prefer eu-west-1 for new sessions where possible. 2) Scale up fallback pool ded-us2-b by +20%.
oncall-sre-janet: Starting reroute policy now. Will flip traffic gradually to avoid thundering herd. :gear:
customer-success-maya: Any expected customer-facing impact? Should we prep status update? CX tickets starting to come in.
oncall-sre-janet: Yes, some requests returning 503 or timing out. Impact: intermittent failures for Hosted API and Dedicated customers in us-east-2. Recommend status page update: "Investigating elevated errors and latency in US East (Ohio)."
status-bot: Status updated: incident created - INVESTIGATING - 4123456789
eng-runtime-omar: Short-term mitigations applied: increased auth-proxy client-side retries with exponential backoff and jitter; lowered token refresh concurrency to reduce pressure on STS calls.
platform-ops-li: Kicked off AWS support case (Case # 123456789). AWS acknowleged regional degradation for STS/IMDS in us-east-2. ETA unknown.
oncall-sre-janet: Handoff plan: I'm on this for the next 30m then will hand to night oncall @oncall-sre-lee. @eng-runtime-omar to continue tracing mitigation and observe KVs.
eng-runtime-omar: Will instrument additional metrics: per-host token error rate, retry-saturation, KV hit rate.
platform-ops-li: For Dedicated customers, enabling fallback to cached tokens where TTL allows (risk assessed) to reduce STS calls. Patching rollout in progress.
customer-success-maya: Drafting customer outbound now: short note about "external AWS credential service issues causing intermittent errors; team mitigations in progress". Will wait for confirmation before posting.
oncall-sre-janet: Can someone confirm any impact to Private (VPC) deployments? I think unaffected but double-checking.
eng-runtime-omar: Private (VPC/on-prem) not affected by AWS STS; confirmed no metric spike in private clusters.
oncall-sre-janet: Good. Priorities: 1) stabilize Hosted & Dedicated 2) avoid noisy restarts 3) keep customers informed.
platform-ops-li: Rolling restart avoided. Using routing + traffic shaping. ded-us2-a CPU is fine, but queue depth high. Draining a few hosts from ded-us2-a to ded-us2-b to rebalance.
oncall-sre-janet: Update: routing flip at 14:09 UTC reduced 5xx rate from 12% -> 4% in 10m. Still elevated but improving. Continuing monitoring.
status-bot: Incident note appended: AWS STS reported partial regional degradation. Case open #123456789.
customer-success-maya: Posting to status page now (short): "We are investigating elevated errors in US East (Ohio). Root cause appears to be a third-party provider (AWS credential service). Mitigations in progress."
oncall-sre-janet: Leaving a troubleshooting checklist on thread before handoff: `- monitor auth-proxy 5xx/latency  - confirm drift in retry queue - verify dedicated pool reroute health - coordinate with AWS support - prepare rollback plan for routing change`
eng-runtime-omar: Noted. Adding a watch: if 5xx > 5% for 5m, escalate to incident leader.
platform-ops-li: AWS updated case: "We are seeing elevated error rates for STS in us-east-2, mitigation underway. No ETA."
oncall-sre-janet: Handing off to @oncall-sre-lee at 14:16 UTC. Summary for oncall-sre-lee: auth/credential provider degraded in us-east-2 -> temporary routing to eu-west-1 + scale ded-us2-b + cached-token fallback applied. AWS case open. Customers notified. Watch for regression.
oncall-sre-lee: Acked, taking over. I'll keep thread active and update every 15m or on changes.
customer-success-maya: Thanks. I'll monitor support tickets and update customers who reported errors.
eng-runtime-omar: Current status: 5xx stabilized ~3% in the last 5m. Continue to watch KV cache thrash; may need to tighten backoff if it climbs.
oncall-sre-lee: If AWS doesn't resolve by EOW, we'll consider moving more routing permanently and open a follow-up for capacity/fallback improvements.
status-bot: Incident status: MONITORING - 4123456789
oncall-sre-lee: Closing note for now: incident mitigated to monitoring, keep AWS case open. Reopen if >5% 5xx or customer impact grows. :white_check_mark:
